edges.reason: Farmer villager is at the end of the stone brick stairs path 35+ blocks northeast from spawn
Shepherd villager who buys orange dye is in the same trading area at the end of the stone brick stairs path
Player starts with 0 apples; must obtain apple through villager trade before consuming it
White terracotta blocks are inside the jungle fence enclosure; must find and enter enclosure to access them
Red concrete powder blocks are inside the jungle fence enclosure alongside the terracotta
A visible chest containing pumpkin_pie is placed inside the jungle fence enclosure near the entrance
A wolf is penned in a sub-area inside the jungle fence enclosure; must find and enter enclosure to engage it
Dark oak planks chest sits on top of terracotta stack; mining terracotta creates step access to the chest and nearby crafting table

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Stone brick stairs are ~35 blocks northeast of spawn at (33,0,30). Max_distance=5 ensures player must actually navigate there (cannot be satisfied from spawn at origin). Facing_tolerance=60 confirms player is looking at the stairs structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Jungle fence enclosure is ~35 blocks northwest of spawn at (-35,1,35). Max_distance=5 ensures player must navigate there. Facing_tolerance=60 confirms player is looking at the fence enclosure.

Uses inventory_has because the player starts with 0 apples and the only source of apples in this scene is the farmer villager trade. Having at least 1 apple in inventory confirms a successful trade occurred.

Uses inventory_has because selling orange dye to the shepherd villager yields emeralds. Player starts with 16 emeralds and spends 1 on apple trade (→15). After selling 2 orange dye for 1 emerald (→16), having ≥16 emeralds confirms the sell transaction occurred after the apple purchase. Dependency graph enforces that trade for Apple precedes this check.

Uses inventory_has because the player starts with 0 apples, trades for 2, then eats one leaving at least 1. Having apple ≥1 confirms the trade-then-eat sequence occurred within the dependency chain. Known limitation: shares trigger condition with trade_for_apple milestone, but dependency ordering provides semantic distinction.

Uses inventory_has because mining white terracotta drops the block as an item into inventory. Player starts with 0 white terracotta and the only source is the terracotta blocks inside the jungle fence enclosure. Having ≥1 confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because mining red concrete powder drops the block as an item into inventory. Player starts with 0 red concrete powder and the only source is the blocks inside the jungle fence enclosure. Having ≥1 confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because pumpkin pie is stored in a chest inside the jungle fence enclosure and the player starts with 0 pumpkin_pie in inventory. Having ≥1 pumpkin_pie confirms the player found the chest, opened it, and took the pie. Known limitation: verifies acquisition rather than consumption, but this is the best available proxy with inventory_has rules.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind=mob, max_count=0 because killing the wolf is the verifiable outcome of combat. The wolf is penned in the back sub-area of the jungle fence enclosure at approximately (-37,0,38). A generous ±20 box centered on the wolf's location ensures it stays within the detection area until actually killed, even if it moves during combat.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_trapdoor places it in the player's inventory. Player starts with 0 dark_oak_trapdoors and must obtain 8 dark_oak_planks from the visible chest at y=3 on top of the terracotta (requiring mining terracotta first to step up), then craft at the crafting table inside the enclosure. Having ≥1 dark_oak_trapdoor confirms successful crafting.

scene_description: An expanded scene with two distant areas in opposite directions from spawn. NORTHEAST (~35 blocks): A stone brick stairs pathway leading to a trading post with a farmer villager (sells apples for emeralds) and a shepherd villager (buys orange dye for emeralds), marked with lanterns. NORTHWEST (~35 blocks): A jungle fence enclosure containing white terracotta blocks (3 layers high) with a visible chest of dark_oak_planks on top at y=3, red concrete powder blocks, a chest with pumpkin_pie near the entrance, a penned wolf in a sub-area, and a crafting table inside. Dirt paths from spawn branch in both directions as navigation cues.
task_text: Explore this area in two directions. To the northeast, find the stone brick stairs path leading to the trading post. Trade with the farmer for apples and eat one. Sell orange dye to the shepherd. To the northwest, find the jungle fence enclosure. Inside, mine white terracotta and red concrete powder. Take pumpkin pie from the chest and eat it. Get dark oak planks from the chest on top of the terracotta and craft a dark oak trapdoor at the crafting table. Combat the wolf penned in the back of the enclosure.
design_notes: FINAL VERSION with all team feedback incorporated. Key changes from earlier iterations: (1) White terracotta now 3 layers high (y=0 to y=2) with chest at y=3 — this is ~1.38 blocks above player eye level (1.62), making it unreachable without stepping up. Player MUST mine at least one terracotta block to create a step to reach the chest, enforcing the mine→craft dependency. (2) Shepherd villager (not cleric) for buying orange dye — correct profession. (3) Structures 35+ blocks from spawn in opposite directions. (4) Red concrete powder INSIDE the enclosure. (5) Pumpkin pie in chest inside enclosure (player starts with 0). (6) Wolf in sub-pen with internal fence wall. (7) Dirt paths as navigation cues. (8) Player hotbar filled with tools + cobblestone filler so chest pickups go to main inventory. (9) Target version: Java Edition 1.19-1.20.4 for NBT trade compatibility. SPATIAL LAYOUT: Spawn at (0,0,0). NE trading post at (~38-42, 0, ~28-33). NW enclosure at (~-39 to ~-31, 0, ~31 to ~39). Enclosure entrance at (~-35, 1-2, ~31) south face. Terracotta at (~-38 to ~-36, 0-2, ~34-36). Planks chest at (~-37, 3, ~35). Red concrete at (~-34 to ~-33, 0-1, ~34-36). Pie chest at (~-35, 0, ~32). Crafting table at (~-33, 0, ~32). Wolf sub-pen: internal fence at y0-2 z=37, wolf at (~-37, 0, ~38).
